Subject: SDLC evidence request: code review + CI credentialing + change custody

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for taking the time on yesterday's call. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake for FinBank we need a concise bundle showing:

- Code review trail for the last 6 months (per-repo PR history, reviewer IDs, timestamps).
- CI credential handling: how ephemeral tokens are issued/revoked, rotation cadence, and who holds long-lived credentials.
- Change approval chronology for production deployments (who approved, ticket IDs, and rollback notes).

Can you provide artifacts or point me to where we can pull the exports? A simple zip with the logs + a one-page narrative is fine. Also list any gaps or controls you plan to add in the next 90 days.

Appreciate a reply by EOD PT Friday (2028-09-01).

Best,
Emma

Senior Assessor, SecureAssess LLC

From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: SDLC evidence request: code review + CI credentialing + change custody

Attaching the requested artifacts (stubs listed below). Notes:
- Code review exports: we ran repo-level PR export for the three repos flagged. The export includes PR ID, author, reviewer(s), merge timestamp, and branch protection status. Exceptions: two PRs had external-collaborator reviews (marked) — redacted PII in export.
- CI credential handling: summary doc describes our ephemeral-auth-service (EAS) workflow — tokens are short-lived (15m), rotated via scheduled job for build agents every 24h, long-lived credentials are only held by ops in the HSM for emergency maintenance; metrics show <0.1% of builds used long-lived creds in last 90 days.
- Change chronology: CSV attached with ticket ID, approver, approval time, deploy run ID, and rollback flag. We also include links to the CD pipeline trace for each deploy.

Attachments (zipped and attached to this thread):
- redwood_code-review-audit-log_2028-07.zip (PR_export_csvs/, README.txt)
- ci-credential-rotation-summary_2028-08.pdf (includes EAS sequence diagram and rotation logs)
- change-approval-chronology.csv (JIRA-IDs and deploy metadata)

Open items we surfaced:
1) We do not correlate reviewer identity to job-role authority in a single table today (we rely on Okta groups + repo access policies). Proposed 90-day improvement: export a reviewer-role mapping and store with PR metadata.
2) Automated snapshots for PR approvals are stored for 60 days; assessor asked for 180-day retention. Roadmap item logged to extend retention when feasible.

I've attached the files to this email and uploaded the zip to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/FINBANK-SDLC-EVIDENCE-2028

-- Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_code-review-audit-log_2028-07.zip; ci-credential-rotation-summary_2028-08.pdf; change-approval-chronology.csv
